newsitem.title: USA: TCA Cable TV Inc unit buys out investor.
newsitem.headline: TCA Cable TV Inc unit buys out investor.

text.p: A TCA Cable TV Inc unit has bought a 50 percent interest in the subisidiary held by Lufkin-Conroe Telecommunications Corp in a deal worth "less than $10 million," a spokesman for TCA Cable said Friday.
TCA Communications Inc acquired the stake in exchange for certain assets.
He said the transaction made TCA Communications a wholly owned subsidiary of TCA Cable TV Inc.
TCA Cable TV serves more than 670,000 basic subscribers in 63 cable television systems in Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas, New Mexico, Mississippi, Oklahoma and Idaho.
